g.title: Browser Client Tier: INGRESS Tech: HTML|CSS|JavaScript Role: End‑user web browser accessing the application [Managed Cloud / External Service]
Next.js Frontend (React) Tier: APPLICATION Tech: Next.js|React|Tailwind Role: SSR/CSR React application serving UI pages File: app/layout.tsx:1
Next.js API Gateway Tier: INTEGRATION Tech: Next.js API Routes Role: Entry point for all HTTP API calls File: pages/api/*:1
NextAuth GitHub OAuth Tier: INTEGRATION Tech: NextAuth|GitHub OAuth Role: Handles user sign‑in via GitHub and issues JWTs File: pages/api/auth/[...nextauth].ts:1
JWT Issuer Tier: INTEGRATION Tech: jsonwebtoken Role: Creates and validates JWT access tokens File: utils/jwt.ts:1
gRPC Monitoring Engine Tier: INGRESS Tech: @grpc/grpc-js Role: Provides CheckTarget RPC for latency checks File: terminal-server/server.ts:1
gRPC Worker (Docker) Tier: INTEGRATION Tech: Node.js|gRPC|Docker Role: Executes stress tests inside Docker containers File: lib/redis/index.ts:1
Socket.io Realtime Server Tier: INGRESS Tech: socket.io|Node.js Role: Pushes live monitor metrics to browsers File: realtime-server/server.js:1
MongoDB Tier: PERSISTENCE Tech: MongoDB Role: Document store for AB logs, users, monitors, wallpapers [Managed Cloud / External Service]
Redis Cache Tier: PERSISTENCE Tech: Redis Role: In‑memory cache for session data, rate‑limiting and stats [Managed Cloud / External Service]
GitHub API Tier: INTEGRATION Tech: GitHub REST Role: External GitHub service for repos, branches, OAuth [Managed Cloud / External Service]
Telegram Bot API Tier: INTEGRATION Tech: Telegram Bot Role: Sends alert messages to configured chat [Managed Cloud / External Service]
Seek API Tier: INTEGRATION Tech: Custom Seek Service Role: Collects AB test results for analytics [Managed Cloud / External Service]
GitHub Actions Runner Tier: INFRASTRUCTURE Tech: GitHub Actions Role: Executes CI/CD pipelines and AB‑test workflow [Managed Cloud / External Service]
Vercel Watchtower API Tier: INTEGRATION Tech: Vercel Role: Cron endpoint invoked by watchtower workflow [Managed Cloud / External Service]
